song.name: Inferno's Trial
song.plot: Eldrin is confronted with a fiery trial — a labyrinth of flames testing his courage and determination. The heat is intense, the air thick with smoke. A crucible that will forge his resolve.
song.analysis: The original is a generic fire trial anthem. The reworked version anchors it to Eldrin's mission: "To seal my own and others' fate" in the chorus, and Verse 1 describes the transition from ice (previous trial) to fire.

section.name: Verse 1
section.original: Flames engulf, a fiery test, A battle waged, against the heat. Strength tested, will unbroken, Through the inferno, a rebirth.
section.reworked: The ice gives way to burning heat, The magma flows beneath my feet. A wall of fire, a gate of flame, That calls me by my given name.

section.name: Pre-Chorus
section.original: In the heart of the blaze, we stand tall, Facing the fire, we won't fall. Embers rise, shadows dance, In the inferno, we take our chance.
section.reworked: In the heart of the blaze, we stand tall, Facing the fire, we won't fall. Embers rise, shadows dance, In the inferno, we take our chance.

section.name: Chorus
section.original: Inferno's trial, a test of might, Through the flames, we fight the night. Burning bright, our spirits soar, In the fire, we take our chance Inferno's trial, a test of might, Through the flames, we fight the night. Burning bright, our spirits soar, In the fire, we find our core.
section.reworked: Inferno's trial, the burning gate, To seal my own and others' fate. It burns the fear, it burns the doubt, And lets the inner fire out.

section.name: Verse 2
section.original: Heat surrounds, a searing pain, Yet through the agony, we remain. Strength within, a force untamed, In the inferno, we're unchained.
section.reworked: Heat surrounds, a searing pain, Yet through the agony, we remain. Strength within, a force untamed, In the inferno, we're unchained.

section.name: Bridge
section.original: Through the fire, we are forged, In the flames, our souls are scourged. Rising from the ashes, we prevail, Inferno's trial, we will not fail.
section.reworked: Through the fire, we are forged, In the flames, our souls are scourged. Rising from the ashes, we prevail, Inferno's trial, we will not fail.

section.name: Interlude
section.original: Inferno's trial, a test of might, Through the flames, we fight the night. Burning bright, our spirits soar, In the fire, we find our core. In the silence, we gather strength, A moment's peace, before the length. Of trials faced, and battles fought, In the inferno, lessons taught.

section.name: Verse 3
section.original: Ashes fall, a new dawn breaks, From the embers, a future makes. Strength renewed, a spirit free, In the inferno, our destiny.
